Test Scenario: Verify successful user registration with valid details
Test Steps: Open Registration page → Enter valid details → Submit registration form
Expected Result: User account is created successfully and user can log in

Test Scenario: Verify successful login with valid credentials
Test Steps: Open Login page → Enter valid credentials → Click Login

Test Scenario: Verify login validation for invalid and mandatory fields
Test Steps: Leave mandatory fields blank → Try login → Enter invalid credentials → Try login

Test Scenario: Verify product search, filter and sorting
Test Steps: Search product → Apply filter → Apply sorting

Test Scenario: Verify adding product to cart and updating quantity
Test Steps: Open product → Add to cart → Update quantity
Expected Result: Product is added and quantity is updated

Test Scenario: Verify mandatory field validation during checkout
Preconditions: Cart contains at least one product
Test Steps: Proceed to checkout → Leave mandatory fields blank → Continue
Expected Result: User cannot continue without required details

Test Scenario: Verify complete purchase flow from login to order confirmation
Test Steps: Login → Search product → Add to cart → Checkout → Place order

Test Scenario: Verify invalid quantity update and duplicate order handling
Test Steps: Update quantity with invalid value → Click Place Order multiple times
Expected Result: Application prevents invalid quantity and duplicate order

Test Scenario: Verify newly placed order is available in order history
Test Steps: Open My Orders → Verify recent order

Test Scenario: Verify critical user journey across supported browsers
Test Steps: Run TC007 on supported browsers and screen sizes
Expected Result: Application works correctly on supported browsers
